# apicurio_group (Data Source)

Looks up a group by id. Fails when the group does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apicurio_group" "payments" {
  group_id = "payments"
}

output "payments_labels" {
  value = data.apicurio_group.payments.labels
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Identifier of the group.

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `id` (String) Same as `group_id`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the group.
- `modified_by` (String) User of the last modification.
- `modified_on` (String) Last modification time (RFC 3339).
- `owner` (String) Owner of the group.
